name: Contractor Foreman
summary: Project management for small contractors with estimating, bid management, change orders, purchase orders and AIA-style invoicing.
differentiator: Bid management and bid comparison are in every plan, including the $49 per month Basic, and the fee is per company rather than per project. That makes it one of the cheapest entries on this list that includes bid management in the starting plan. Basic covers one user, so teams quickly move to Standard ($105, three users) or Plus ($166, eight users).
pricing: Annual plans: Basic $49 per month (1 user), Standard $105 (3 users), Plus $166 (8 users), Pro $221 (15 users) and Unlimited $332 per month. Quarterly billing costs about 25 percent more and Basic is not offered quarterly. 30-day free trial and a 100-day money-back guarantee on annual plans.
whoPays: Subscriber pays per plan; fixed regardless of project volume
bestFor: Small contractors who need bid comparison and project management at a low fixed price.
skipIf: You need a bid network that sends invitations to a large sub database.
